question:
A certain store has formulated a purchasing and selling plan for a certain product from July to December. It is known that the store's warehouse capacity cannot exceed 500 units. By the end of June, there are already 200 units in stock. From then on, the store will purchase once at the beginning of each month. Assuming the purchase and selling prices of the product for each month are as shown in Table 1-21, how many units should be purchased and sold each month to maximize total revenue?

Table 1-21
\begin{tabular}{c|cccccc}
\hline Month & 7 & 8 & 9 & 10 & 11 & 12 \\
\hline Purchase & 28 & 24 & 25 & 27 & 23 & 23 \\
\hline Sale & 29 & 24 & 26 & 28 & 22 & 25 \\
\hline Sale & 29 & 24 & 26 & 28 & 22 & 25 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

candidates.code:
"""
Purchasing and selling plan July-December — maximize total net revenue.

DECISION VARIABLES
  buy[t]  int units purchased at start of month t (t=0..5)
              domain: NonNegativeIntegers
  sell[t] int units sold during month t (t=0..5)
              domain: NonNegativeIntegers
  inv[t]  int units of stock at END of month t
              domain: NonNegativeIntegers, upper bound 500

OBJECTIVE (maximize)
  total net income = sum_t  sale_price[t]*sell[t] - purchase_price[t]*buy[t]

CONSTRAINTS
  (1) Inventory balance each month t
        inv[t-1] + buy[t] - sell[t] = inv[t]
      with inv[-1] = initial 200 at end of June.
  (2) Warehouse capacity each month
        0 <= inv[t] <= 500

DATA contents replicate Table 1-21 prices & specs.
"""

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    # months mapped in order: Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec (indices 0..5)
    "T": 6,
    "purchase_price": [28, 24, 25, 27, 23, 23],
    "sale_price": [29, 24, 26, 28, 22, 25],
    "inv_start": 200,      # end June stock
    "inv_bound": 500,      # store capacity <= 500 units
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.T = pyo.RangeSet(0, d["T"] - 1)

    # ---- variables ----
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers,
                        bounds=(0, d["inv_bound"]))

    # ---- objective ----
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["sale_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
                   - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
                   for t in m.T)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ---- inventory balance ----
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["inv_start"] if t == 0 else m.inv[t - 1]
        return prev + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.inv[t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    return model

DATA = {
    "months":        [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12],
    "purch_price":   {7: 28, 8: 24, 9: 25, 10: 27, 11: 23, 12: 23},
    "sale_price":    {7: 29, 8: 24, 9: 26, 10: 28, 11: 22, 12: 25},
    "initial_stock": 200,
    "capacity":      500,
    "zero":          0,
}

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ---- Set ----
    model.Months = pyo.Set(initialize=months)

    # Predecessor mapping (first month has no predecessor)
    prev_of = {}
    for idx, m in enumerate(months):
        prev_of[m] = months[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else None

    # ---- Variables ----
    def buy_bounds(m):
        return (d["zero"], d["capacity"])

    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.Months, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                        bounds=buy_bounds)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.Months, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                         bounds=buy_bounds)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(model.Months, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                          bounds=buy_bounds)

    # ---- Objective: maximise total profit ----
    def obj_expr(m):
        return sum(d["sale_price"][t] * m.sell[t]
                   - d["purch_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
                   for t in m.Months)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=obj_expr(model), sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ---- Inventory balance ----
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        if prev_of[t] is None:
            return m.stock[t] == d["initial_stock"] + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t]
        return m.stock[t] == m.stock[prev_of[t]] + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.Months, rule=balance_rule)

    # ---- Sales cannot exceed available stock ----
    def sales_limit_rule(m, t):
        if prev_of[t] is None:
            return m.sell[t] <= d["initial_stock"] + m.buy[t]
        return m.sell[t] <= m.stock[prev_of[t]] + m.buy[t]
    model.sales_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.Months, rule=sales_limit_rule)

    # ---- Warehouse capacity ----
    def capacity_rule(m, t):
        return m.stock[t] <= d["capacity"]
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.Months, rule=capacity_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12],
    "purchase_price": {7: 28, 8: 24, 9: 25, 10: 27, 11: 23, 12: 23},
    "sale_price":     {7: 29, 8: 24, 9: 26, 10: 28, 11: 22, 12: 25},
    "capacity": 500,
    "initial_stock": 200,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)

    # Decision variables (units are integers)
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.stock = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Objective: maximise net revenue = sales income - purchase cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(
            d["sale_price"][t] * m.sell[t] - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.buy[t]
            for t in m.T
        )
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Inventory balance: prev stock + buy - sell = end stock
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_stock"] if t == d["months"][0] else m.stock[prev_period(t, d)]
        return prev + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.stock[t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Warehouse capacity
    def capacity_rule(m, t):
        return m.stock[t] <= d["capacity"]
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    # Cannot sell more than available (prev stock + purchase)
    def available_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_stock"] if t == d["months"][0] else m.stock[prev_period(t, d)]
        return m.sell[t] <= prev + m.buy[t]
    model.available = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=available_rule)

    return model


def prev_period(t, d):
    months = d["months"]
    idx = months.index(t)
    return months[idx - 1]

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "months": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
    "purchase_price": {1: 28, 2: 24, 3: 25, 4: 27, 5: 23, 6: 23},
    "sale_price":     {1: 29, 2: 24, 3: 26, 4: 28, 5: 22, 6: 25},
    "capacity": 500,
    "initial_inventory": 200,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.M = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)

    # Decisions: units purchased, units sold, ending inventory per month
    model.p = pyo.Var(model.M, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.M, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.I = pyo.Var(model.M, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      bounds=(0, d["capacity"]))

    # Objective: maximize revenue = sales income minus purchase cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["sale_price"][t] * m.s[t] - d["purchase_price"][t] * m.p[t]
                   for t in m.M)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Inventory balance: I_{t-1} + p_t - s_t = I_t  (initial stock for t=1)
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_inventory"] if t == 1 else m.I[t - 1]
        return prev + m.p[t] - m.s[t] == m.I[t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.M, rule=balance_rule)

    # Warehouse capacity: I_t <= 500  (also enforced via bounds)
    def cap_rule(m, t):
        return m.I[t] <= d["capacity"]
    model.cap = pyo.Constraint(model.M, rule=cap_rule)

    return model

DATA = {

    "purchase_price": {7: 28, 8: 24, 9: 25, 10: 27, 11: 23, 12: 23},
    "sale_price":     {7: 29, 8: 24, 9: 26, 10: 28, 11: 22, 12: 25},
    "capacity": 500,      # warehouse capacity limit (units)
    "init_inv": 200,      # inventory at end of June / start of July
}

GOLD_ANSWER = None


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    months = d["months"]
    pu = d["purchase_price"]
    sp = d["sale_price"]
    cap = d["capacity"]
    inv0 = d["init_inv"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel(name="store_purchase_sell_plan")

    # --- Sets / indices ---------------------------------------------------
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=months, ordered=True)  # time periods (months)

    # --- Variables --------------------------------------------------------
    # units purchased at beginning of month t
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, cap))
    # units sold during month t
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, cap))
    # ending inventory at month t (must respect warehouse capacity)
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, cap))

    # --- Objective: maximize total net revenue ----------------------------
    def rule_obj(m):
        return sum(sp[t] * m.sell[t] - pu[t] * m.buy[t] for t in m.T)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=rule_obj, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # --- Constraints ------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) Inventory balance: previous stock + purchase - sale = ending stock
    def rule_balance(m, t):
        prev = inv0 if t == m.T.first() else m.inv[m.T.prev(t)]
        return m.inv[t] == prev + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t]
    model.balance_con = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=rule_balance)

    # 2) Cannot sell more than is available in the month
    #    (available = prev stock + this month's purchase)
    def rule_sell_avail(m, t):
        prev = inv0 if t == m.T.first() else m.inv[m.T.prev(t)]
        return m.sell[t] <= prev + m.buy[t]
    model.sell_avail_con = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=rule_sell_avail)

    # 3) Warehouse capacity each month (end-of-month stock limited)
    def rule_capacity_end(m, t):
        return m.inv[t] <= cap
    model.capacity_end_con = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=rule_capacity_end)

    # 4) Warehouse capacity check including this month's stock before sale
    #    (purchases + prev stock must fit physically even momentarily)
    def rule_capacity_buy(m, t):
        prev = inv0 if t == m.T.first() else m.inv[m.T.prev(t)]
        return prev + m.buy[t] <= cap
    model.capacity_buy_con = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=rule_capacity_buy)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   buy[t]  : units purchased at the beginning of month t   (t in T), >= 0
#   sell[t] : units sold during month t                     (t in T), >= 0
#   inv[t]  : units in stock at the END of month t          (t in T), >= 0
#             (inv at end of June = initial_inventory = 200)
#
# Objective (maximize): total revenue = sum_t sale_price[t] * sell[t]
#   (purchase costs are not deducted; the problem asks to maximize revenue)
#
# Constraints
#   (1) Inventory balance for each month t:
#         inv_{t-1} + buy[t] - sell[t] = inv[t]
#       where inv_{t-1} for the first month is the initial inventory (200).
#       Source: "the store will purchase once at the beginning of each month"
#               and stock carried over month to month.
#   (2) Warehouse capacity: inv[t] <= capacity (500) for every month t.
#       Source: "the store's warehouse capacity cannot exceed 500 units".
#   (3) Sales cannot exceed available stock (implied by inv[t] >= 0, which
#       together with the balance equation enforces sell[t] <= inv_{t-1}+buy[t]).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DATA = {
    "months": [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12],
    "purchase_price": {7: 28, 8: 24, 9: 25, 10: 27, 11: 23, 12: 23},
    "sale_price":     {7: 29, 8: 24, 9: 26, 10: 28, 11: 22, 12: 25},
    "initial_inventory": 200,   # units in stock at end of June
    "capacity": 500,            # warehouse capacity (upper bound on stock)
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["months"], ordered=True)

    # Decision variables
    model.buy = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.sell = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                        bounds=(0, d["capacity"]))

    # Objective: maximize total sales revenue
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["sale_price"][t] * m.sell[t] for t in m.T)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # (1) Inventory balance with initial inventory for the first month
    def balance_rule(m, t):
        prev = d["initial_inventory"] if t == d["months"][0] else m.inv[d["months"][d["months"].index(t) - 1]]
        return prev + m.buy[t] - m.sell[t] == m.inv[t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # (2) Warehouse capacity on end-of-month stock
    def capacity_rule(m, t):
        return m.inv[t] <= d["capacity"]
    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    return model
